name: subagent_command
description: Inspect or cancel bash commands owned by this child. Cancellation stops only the selected command, not the agent. Check terminal state before finishing.

action.description: Inspect retained bash command state or request cancellation of one exact command without stopping the child agent.

toolCallId.description: Exact retained bash tool-call ID. Required for cancel; omit for status to list this child's retained commands.

waitMs.description: Wait up to this many milliseconds for the selected command to settle before returning its state; defaults to zero and does not stop the command.
